Show why the second document still matches the predicate, and distinguish exhaustion from a nonmatching rule.

Suggest materializing the known finite small rule stream once at the caller before calling update_multiple. Explain the finite-memory boundary; do not promise support for an unbounded stream or invent a new public method.
